conceptual_change: Shifted from price level momentum to a relative trend intensity indicator by comparing the current distance from VWAP against its own 20-period moving average. This captures accelerating trend regimes where the current divergence significantly exceeds the short-term mean, distinguishing persistent trend momentum from simple volatility expansions.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
